projects.name: Book.io
projects.summary: Digital publishing and ownership platform for eBooks and audiobooks, allowing authors and publishers to release blockchain-backed editions that readers can own, read, gift and resell. Book.io began on Cardano and now operates as a multichain platform.
projects.editorial_note: Book.io originated in the Cardano ecosystem but is not Cardano-exclusive. Authors and publishers can self-publish eBooks and audiobooks through the platform, and Book.io now operates across multiple chains. Book.io and Stuff.io share the same founding team and digital-library ecosystem, with Stuff.io extending the model into wider digital media. Book.io has publicly disclosed investment/backing from Mark Cuban, Ingram Content Group, BDMI/Bertelsmann and the Hoskinson Family Office.
projects.founder_lead: Joshua Stone — CEO & Co-founder; Ben Illian — Chief Growth Officer & Co-founder

projects.name: Stuff.io
projects.summary: Digital media publishing and ownership platform where creators can release books, music, video, podcasts and other media as ownable digital assets, while fans can keep, gift, trade or resell what they buy. Built by the Book.io team and multichain by design, including Cardano and Base.
projects.editorial_note: Stuff.io is the broader digital-media sister platform to Book.io, operated by the same team. Its creator tools support publishing across books, music, video, podcasts and other media. The platform is multichain by design, so INDEX:80 records its continuing Cardano presence without implying Cardano exclusivity. The wider Book.io/Stuff.io ecosystem has attracted backing from Mark Cuban, Ingram Content Group, BDMI/Bertelsmann and the Hoskinson Family Office; the Hoskinson investment announcement specifically names both Stuff.io and Book.io.
projects.founder_lead: Joshua Stone — CEO & Co-founder; Ben Illian — Chief Growth Officer & Co-founder

projects.name: Anastasia Labs
projects.summary: Cardano engineering and security studio building smart-contract tooling, protocol infrastructure and open-source projects including Midgard and Lucid Evolution.
projects.editorial_note: Anastasia Labs is an active Cardano engineering studio providing audits, protocol design and development while maintaining open-source ecosystem tooling.

projects.name: Xerberus
projects.summary: Open DeFi risk-rating platform mapping structural risk across assets, protocols, organisations and vaults with transparent methodology and verifiable sources.
projects.editorial_note: Xerberus is an active risk-intelligence platform. Its current product covers DeFi pools, assets, protocols and organisations beyond Cardano while retaining substantial Cardano/Catalyst roots.

projects.name: SIDAN Lab
projects.summary: Hong Kong-based Cardano engineering and open-source tooling group building developer SDKs, governance infrastructure and Hydra-based DeFi systems.
projects.editorial_note: SIDAN Lab builds and maintains Cardano developer, governance and trading infrastructure, including SDK work and Hydra-based systems.

projects.name: Wada
projects.summary: Africa- and diaspora-focused Web3 and AI community incubator operating local hubs, education programmes and developer support with deep Cardano ecosystem involvement.
projects.editorial_note: Wada remains active through a network of African and diaspora hubs, education and innovation programmes, including the Cardano Africa Tech Summit ecosystem.

projects.name: Blink Labs
projects.summary: UTxO blockchain engineering company building and maintaining Cardano node, protocol, indexing and infrastructure software, and operating managed Cardano infrastructure with TxPipe.
projects.editorial_note: Blink Labs actively builds Cardano protocol and node software including gOuroboros, Adder and Dingo, and is an infrastructure partner for Demeter.

projects.name: Lido Nation
projects.summary: Cardano education, community and governance platform publishing learning resources, ecosystem reporting and Catalyst discovery tools.
projects.editorial_note: Lido Nation remains an active Cardano education and community platform and develops governance/Catalyst discovery tools.

projects.name: Sustainable ADA
projects.summary: Cardano sustainability and impact initiative connecting blockchain education, sustainable development, impact measurement and real-world use cases.
projects.editorial_note: Sustainable ADA is an active Cardano-focused sustainability and impact initiative publishing education, case studies and impact resources.

projects.name: Five Binaries
projects.summary: Cardano infrastructure engineering company founded by Marek Mahut and best known as the team behind Blockfrost, with a long record of APIs, SDKs and open-source ecosystem tooling.
projects.editorial_note: Five Binaries is the infrastructure engineering company founded by Marek Mahut behind Blockfrost. Its public footprint is now much more visible through Blockfrost than through the sparse Five Binaries corporate site, while the linked Catalyst record documents a substantial history of developer-tooling work.

projects.name: Keyboard Warriors Internet Cafe
projects.summary: Cardano gaming and NFT ecosystem combining the KWICVERSE, a cross-project game launcher, stakable NFT collections and the $KWIC native token.
projects.editorial_note: The official project site documents KWICVERSE, the KWIC Launcher, NFT staking and the $KWIC Cardano native token. The project describes its official launch as November 2022 and remains represented by an active Australian company.
projects.team_entity: Keyboard Warriors Internet Cafe Pty Ltd

projects.name: European Cardano Community
projects.summary: European Cardano community network connecting builders, educators and ecosystem participants through biweekly town halls, workshops, events and collaborative initiatives across Europe.
projects.editorial_note: The European Cardano Community is a regional Cardano network bringing together builders, educators and ecosystem participants across Europe. Its community channels organise biweekly EU Town Halls, workshops and collaborative activities, with public resources maintained across X, Discord, GitHub and YouTube.

projects.name: Tweag
projects.summary: Software engineering and high-assurance lab contributing to Cardano core infrastructure, protocol research, formal methods, smart-contract audits and open-source developer tooling.
projects.editorial_note: Tweag by Modus Create is a software engineering and high-assurance lab with a substantial Cardano role spanning core protocol and infrastructure work, formal methods, open-source tooling and smart-contract audits. Its dedicated Cardano programme currently highlights work including Ouroboros Peras, cooked-validators and Genesis Sync Accelerator.

projects.name: PERPs
projects.summary: Cardano NFT and community project combining the PERPs character collection with staking and raffles, the $PERP token and the Into The Factions comic universe.
projects.editorial_note: PERPs is a Cardano-native NFT and community project spanning its core character collection, staking and raffle services, the $PERP token and the Into The Factions comic universe.

projects.name: Cardano Foundation
projects.summary: Independent Swiss not-for-profit advancing Cardano as public digital infrastructure through ecosystem stewardship, adoption, education, standards and institutional engagement.
projects.editorial_note: The Cardano Foundation is an independent Swiss not-for-profit that supports Cardano as public digital infrastructure through ecosystem stewardship, adoption, education, standards and engagement with organisations and institutions.

projects.name: EMURGO
projects.summary: Cardano co-founding commercial adoption company supporting the ecosystem through investment, partnerships, education, infrastructure and products including Yoroi.
projects.editorial_note: EMURGO is one of the three organisations that launched Cardano and historically served as its commercial adoption arm. It remains active through investment, partnerships, education, infrastructure and real-world asset tokenization.
projects.founder_lead: Ken Kodama — Founder & Chairman; Phillip Pon — CEO

projects.name: Neo Vikings
projects.summary: Cardano-native project combining NFT community, $NV staking and Bitcoin-mining infrastructure and services for projects and individuals.
projects.editorial_note: Neo Vikings began as a Cardano NFT project and now presents itself around Bitcoin-mining solutions for projects and individuals, alongside $NV and NFT staking. Its legacy project hub still points to the sunset JPG Store, so INDEX:80 surfaces Wayup as Cardano's current NFT marketplace and the live NV staking platform.

projects.name: Libertum
projects.summary: Regulated multichain real-world-asset tokenization platform supporting Cardano CIP-20 issuance on mainnet and CIP-113 programmable security tokens on Cardano Preview, alongside Base.
projects.editorial_note: Libertum is a regulated, multichain tokenization platform for real-world assets. Its current documentation states that CIP-20 issuance is live on Cardano Mainnet, while CIP-113 programmable security tokens are on Cardano Preview pending audit clearance for mainnet; Base is also supported.

projects.name: Butane
projects.summary: Open Cardano synthetic-assets protocol using collateralized debt positions to let users mint and manage synthetic assets against Cardano-native collateral.
projects.editorial_note: Butane is an open synthetic-assets protocol built on Cardano. Its model uses collateralized debt positions backed by Cardano-native assets, with protocol documentation and open-source repositories available publicly.

projects.name: Anvil Dev Agency
projects.summary: Cardano-focused Web3 development and infrastructure company providing APIs, transaction and minting tooling, SDKs, rewards systems and custom development, and the team behind Wayup.
projects.editorial_note: Anvil Development Agency builds Cardano developer infrastructure and project services spanning APIs, transaction and minting tooling, SDKs and custom Web3 development. Anvil is also the team behind the Wayup marketplace.
projects.founder_lead: David Desjardins (Tqueri) — CTO/Founder; Patrick Bernard (PB) — COO/Founder; Zack Soesbee (Cash) — CEO/Founder

projects.name: GranADA Pool
projects.summary: Swiss Cardano stake pool with a sustainability focus, operated as an independent single-pool infrastructure project.
projects.editorial_note: GranADA Pool is a Swiss Cardano stake pool with a sustainability focus, operated as an independent single-pool infrastructure project. INDEX:80 links to the pool's current official site and X account and records it as stake-pool infrastructure rather than a financial product.

projects.name: Digital Fortress (DIGI)
projects.summary: Family-owned Cardano stake-pool operation running the DIGI pool family on independent bare-metal and backup infrastructure, led by Rick McCracken and family.
projects.editorial_note: Digital Fortress is a family-operated Cardano stake-pool infrastructure project led by Rick McCracken, using independent bare-metal and backup infrastructure. INDEX:80 links to the current project site, X account and an on-chain DIGI pool record.

projects.name: Ikigai Technologies
projects.summary: Web3 technology company building gaming infrastructure and open-source Cardano tooling, including Hydra auction infrastructure and the GENUN Games ecosystem.
projects.editorial_note: Ikigai Technologies is a Web3 technology company building gaming infrastructure and open-source Cardano tooling. Its current work includes Hydra auction infrastructure, Grabbit, GENUN Games and other Catalyst-backed research and development.

projects.name: Dotare
projects.summary: Cardano-based universal basic income platform and decentralized endowment using pledged ADA, staking rewards and DeFi yield to fund recurring beneficiary distributions.
projects.editorial_note: Dotare is a Cardano-based universal basic income platform and decentralized endowment. Benefactors pledge ADA, which generates staking and DeFi yield used to support recurring beneficiary distributions; Dotare also operates the DOTAR stake pool and ADA D redemption token.
projects.founder_lead: Christopher Erckert — Co-founder, CEO; Dorien Pine — Co-founder

projects.name: Adastack.io
projects.summary: Curated Cardano ecosystem explorer and directory for discovering DApps, wallets, tools, projects and related resources, with structured project links and a developer API.
projects.editorial_note: Adastack.io is a Cardano ecosystem discovery directory covering projects, DApps, wallets, governance, development resources, on-chain metrics and more. It also exposes structured project information through a public developer API.

projects.name: AdaLite
projects.summary: Lightweight open-source Cardano web wallet by Vacuumlabs, supporting mnemonic and hardware-wallet access without requiring users to run a full Cardano node.
projects.editorial_note: AdaLite is a lightweight open-source Cardano web wallet developed by Vacuumlabs. It supports mnemonic and hardware-wallet access and remains listed among Cardano wallet options.

projects.name: Chibidango Heroes
projects.summary: Cardano-native collectible hero project built around NFTs and an idle-RPG game concept with battling, crafting, summoning and a player economy.
projects.editorial_note: Chibidango Heroes is a Cardano collectible-hero and game project. Its official whitepaper describes NFT heroes, battling, crafting, summoning and an in-game economy; the whitepaper still frames the game as upcoming, so INDEX:80 does not imply a fully launched game.
projects.founder_lead: Oleg Terehovich — Co-founder/CEO; Vitaly Volkov — Co-founder/CTO; Aigars Alabins — Co-founder/Art Director

projects.name: Empowa
projects.summary: Housing-finance platform for affordable, climate-smart homes in emerging markets, using tokenised RWA structures and blockchain-backed collateral alongside fiat funding rails.
projects.editorial_note: Empowa finances affordable, climate-smart housing in emerging markets. Its current model combines fiat housing finance with a blockchain-community layer using EMP token collateral, NFT-backed participation and an on-chain reserve.

projects.name: Genius Yield
projects.summary: Cardano DeFi platform that combined the Genius DEX with programmable Smart Swaps, concentrated liquidity and automated liquidity-management tools. Genius Yield announced that operations will cease on 15 October 2026; INDEX:80 retains the project as an archived historical record.
projects.editorial_note: Genius Yield combined the Genius DEX with programmable Smart Swaps, concentrated liquidity and automated liquidity-management tooling. Genius Yield announced that operations will cease on 15 October 2026, and its X/social presence is no longer available. INDEX:80 retains this page as an archived historical Cardano DeFi record.

projects.name: Spectrum Finance
projects.summary: Former open-source cross-chain DEX spanning Cardano and Ergo. Spectrum Labs announced the project's closure and discontinued project work in August 2025; retained here as a historical Cardano DeFi record.
projects.editorial_note: Spectrum Finance was an open-source cross-chain DEX with Cardano and Ergo support. Spectrum Labs issued an official closure notice on 7 August 2025 and discontinued project-related work, so INDEX:80 retains this page as an archived historical record.

projects.name: Daedalus
projects.summary: Open-source full-node desktop wallet for ada that runs Cardano node and wallet backends locally, providing trustless transaction validation and governance support.
projects.editorial_note: Daedalus is Input Output's open-source full-node desktop wallet for ada. Unlike light wallets, it runs Cardano node and wallet components locally so users validate the blockchain through their own node.

projects.name: Rosen Bridge
projects.summary: Open-source cross-chain bridge using an Ergo-centric Watcher/Guard architecture to transfer assets between Ergo, Cardano and other supported chains.
projects.editorial_note: Rosen Bridge is an open-source interoperability project using a Watcher/Guard architecture to move assets between Ergo, Cardano and other supported chains.

projects.name: Typhon Wallet
projects.summary: Non-custodial Cardano web and browser-extension wallet from Strica with staking, NFTs, hardware-wallet support, multi-account delegation and CIP-30 dApp connectivity.
projects.editorial_note: Typhon Wallet is a non-custodial Cardano wallet from Strica available on the web and as a browser extension, with staking, NFT, hardware-wallet, multi-account and CIP-30 dApp features.

projects.name: NuFi
projects.summary: Non-custodial multichain wallet with first-class Cardano support for staking, dApps, hardware wallets, NFTs and integrated token exchange.
projects.editorial_note: NuFi is a non-custodial multichain wallet with substantial Cardano support, including staking, dApp connectivity, hardware-wallet integration, NFTs and in-wallet exchange features.
projects.founder_lead: Michal Petro — CEO; Rafael Korbas — CTO

projects.name: Oura
projects.summary: Rust-native Cardano data pipeline from TxPipe for streaming chain events from nodes or relays through configurable filters into databases, queues, webhooks and other sinks.
projects.editorial_note: Oura is TxPipe's Rust-native Cardano data pipeline for streaming chain events through configurable filters into storage, queues, webhooks and other downstream systems. INDEX:80 links to the current Oura v2 documentation.

projects.name: Palmyra
projects.summary: Cardano-linked commodity marketplace and RWA tokenization project connecting producers and buyers in underserved commodity markets through the PALM Economy.
projects.editorial_note: Palmyra is a commodity marketplace and tokenization project connected to the PALM Economy, using Cardano-linked infrastructure to connect producers and buyers in underserved real-world commodity markets.

projects.name: DirectEd
projects.summary: Education and talent-development organisation with a history of Cardano-based scholarship, credential and tutorial-voucher projects; its current public site now focuses primarily on engineering training and job placement.
projects.editorial_note: DirectEd has a substantial history in the Cardano ecosystem through Catalyst-funded scholarship, credential and education projects, including Atala PRISM work. Its current public site is focused mainly on engineering training and job placement, so INDEX:80 marks the Cardano relationship as historical/currently uncertain rather than implying an active Cardano product.

projects.name: SpaceBudz
projects.summary: Early Cardano NFT collection launched in 2021 and a defining heritage project in the chain's NFT history, with a current official collection site and explorer.
projects.editorial_note: SpaceBudz is an early Cardano NFT collection launched in 2021 and retained as an important heritage project. The official site remains available with a live collection explorer and canonical policy ID.

projects.name: HOSKY
projects.summary: Long-running Cardano community token and meme project with Rug Pool staking rewards, NFTs and the Fetch by HOSKY DEX aggregator.
projects.editorial_note: HOSKY is a long-running Cardano community token and meme project. Its current site also covers Rug Pool staking rewards, NFT collections and Fetch by HOSKY, a Cardano DEX aggregator. The project itself states that the token has no intrinsic value or expectation of financial return.

projects.name: GNP1 / GrahamsNumberPlus1
projects.summary: Cardano stake pool and ecosystem tooling project operating since 2020, with zero-fee delegation rebates, self-hosted node/db-sync infrastructure, free explorer tools, Plutus smart-contract experiments, DRep participation and mental-health charity work.
projects.editorial_note: GNP1 is a Cardano stake pool and ecosystem tooling project active since October 2020. Its current public work includes self-hosted Cardano infrastructure, free chain and pool tools, Plutus smart-contract experiments, governance participation as a DRep, and a mental-health charity mission.

projects.name: Strica
projects.summary: Cardano engineering team building CardanoScan, Typhon Wallet and open-source developer libraries for the Cardano ecosystem.
projects.editorial_note: Strica is the engineering team behind CardanoScan and Typhon Wallet and publishes open-source Cardano libraries used across both products.

projects.name: .zkdid
projects.summary: Zero-knowledge identity and decentralised DNS/trust-resolution project developing holder-controlled identity roots and privacy-preserving proofs for people, AI agents and devices.
projects.editorial_note: .zkdid is developing a holder-controlled identity and trust-resolution layer built around decentralised DNS and zero-knowledge proofs. Its current site presents a working Wallet Alpha v1.0 and explicitly frames the project as token-free public-good infrastructure. INDEX:80 records it as adjacent identity infrastructure through an editor-approved Cardano-community referral; the current public site is chain-neutral and should not be described as Cardano-native.

projects.name: Stakada.io
projects.summary: Cardano stake-pool directory and website-tooling service that lets SPOs browse pools and embed live pool information, delegation tools and related widgets into their own websites.
projects.editorial_note: Stakada.io is a Cardano stake-pool discovery and web-tooling service. It provides embeddable pool information and delegation tools for stake-pool websites and surfaces views for Mission Driven Pools, xSPO alliance members and pools using Stakada embeds.

projects.name: Larissa.Health
projects.summary: Digital maternal-health and midwifery project developing practitioner verification, privacy-preserving identity and AI-governance infrastructure, with Cardano-linked funding and participation through its BIRTH stake pool.
projects.editorial_note: Larissa.Health is developing digital infrastructure for maternal health and midwifery, including practitioner verification, self-sovereign identity and AI-governance concepts. Its current roadmap distinguishes completed Web3/stake-pool operations from application, tokenomics and AI components that are still planned or developing. The project operates the Cardano BIRTH stake pool as part of its funding and decentralised-infrastructure model.
projects.founder_lead: Marcus M. Ubani — CEO/Co-Founder; Wibke Ubani — CPO/Co-Founder

projects.name: Adria Stake Pool
projects.summary: Independent Cardano single stake pool operating since 2021, supporting decentralization and ecosystem discovery through the DappsOnCardano analytics platform.
projects.editorial_note: Adria Stake Pool is an independent single-pool Cardano operator active since 2021. Its current maintained public destination is DappsOnCardano, an active Cardano ecosystem analytics and discovery site whose footer identifies it as powered by ADRIA Pool. INDEX:80 records ADRIA as Community Stake Pool infrastructure; changing stake levels and delegation outcomes are time-sensitive and are not editorial endorsements.

projects.name: PoolFlow
projects.summary: Cardano token-market analytics interface with live trade feeds, trending-token views, portfolio tools and wallet watchlist/profiler features.
projects.editorial_note: PoolFlow is a live Cardano market-data interface with token rankings, trade feeds, portfolio and wallet-analysis routes. At the 20 September 2026 review, some headline metrics and live tables were still loading or showing placeholders, so INDEX:80 will keep the record under review as the product matures.

projects.name: Cardano PRIME
projects.summary: Community-coordinated Cardano DeFi growth proposal led by AlphaGrowth, combining ecosystem audit, protocol readiness work, incentives and capital-deployment planning.
projects.editorial_note: Cardano PRIME is a proposed 12-month DeFi growth program rather than an operating dApp. AlphaGrowth's June 2026 public draft describes a ₳120 million treasury request, phased ecosystem audit and implementation work, incentives and capital deployment, with several governance and administrative roles still to be finalized before an on-chain vote.

projects.name: Trivolve Tech
projects.summary: Blockchain and AI product studio delivering Cardano-based government and enterprise systems, including forensic chain-of-custody infrastructure and the IndianChain agriculture project.
projects.editorial_note: Trivolve Tech develops blockchain and AI systems for enterprise and government use. Cardano Foundation reported in June 2026 that Trivolve's Forensic Management System had surpassed 100,000 Cardano mainnet transactions. Its funded IndianChain work with Quixy is integrating Cardano technology into an agriculture-settlement system for Telangana, with the current Catalyst record still showing the project in progress. The Treasury funding shown is linked Catalyst funding for the IndianChain proposal, not a claim that Trivolve Tech as a whole received it.

projects.name: Ascend Market
projects.summary: Midnight-based leveraged event-perpetuals platform supporting Cardano, EVM and Solana environments, with trading and settlement logic finalized on Midnight using zero-knowledge proofs.
projects.editorial_note: Ascend is a leveraged event-perpetuals platform built on Midnight. Its current site and documentation state that Cardano, EVM and Solana environments are supported while trading, risk, account and settlement logic is finalized on Midnight. Midnight's August 2026 network update records Ascend as a launched application on the network.

projects.name: Sundial Protocol
projects.summary: UTXO-native Bitcoin Layer-2 and yield infrastructure project with active Cardano-side components in its public codebase, including ADA smart contracts and Cardano bridge tooling.
projects.editorial_note: Sundial's current public positioning is primarily Bitcoin infrastructure: a UTXO-native Bitcoin Layer-2, bridge and yield stack. INDEX:80 includes it because current Sundial code and technical material still contain active Cardano components, including ADA locker contracts and a charms-cardano bridge implementation written in Aiken. The record should be revisited if that Cardano component becomes immaterial.

projects.name: SongMarketCap / $SONG
projects.summary: Cardano music and media ecosystem producing AI-assisted NFT songs through Stuff.io, alongside the $SONG utility token, fan/gallery tools, Cardano news and community swap features.
projects.editorial_note: SongMarketCap combines Cardano-native music publishing, community media and token utility. It creates AI-assisted NFT songs and uses Stuff.io's creator portal for minting and sales; its own Whitepaper 2.0 explicitly says this is not a formal partnership. The wider ecosystem includes the $SONG utility token, My Backstage fan/gallery tools, Cardano News and DreamBigSwap, whose current swap provider changed from DexHunter to Gero NEXUS on 16 September 2026.

projects.name: AlphaGrowth
projects.summary: Multichain DeFi operations and ecosystem-growth company providing protocol strategy, liquidity, business-development and market-expansion services, and leading the Cardano PRIME programme.
projects.editorial_note: AlphaGrowth is a multichain DeFi operations and ecosystem-growth company working across protocol growth, liquidity, business development and operational strategy. Its current Cardano role includes leading Cardano PRIME, a separate community-coordinated DeFi growth programme that INDEX:80 records independently.

projects.name: BBHMM
projects.summary: Independent single Cardano stake pool operating since 2020, with current delegation tooling and documented participation in wider ecosystem infrastructure.
projects.editorial_note: BBHMM is an independent Cardano stake-pool operator with a current public delegation surface. Its site also documents participation in projects including TosiDrop, NuNet and World Mobile; those contribution claims should be rechecked at future editorial reviews.

projects.name: OLi / Oli Tutor
projects.summary: Live AI tutoring platform by Olympus Insights; Cardano wallet, credential and reward integration is currently proposed through a Project Catalyst Fund15 application.
projects.editorial_note: OLi is a live AI tutoring product. Its Cardano integration is proposed in Fund15 and should not be described as deployed or funded unless the proposal status and delivered integration are later verified.

projects.name: Open DJED / Artifi Labs
projects.summary: Open-source community interface and off-chain tooling for interacting with the existing DJED protocol on Cardano, maintained by Artifi Labs.
projects.editorial_note: Open DJED is an interface and tooling layer for the existing DJED protocol; it is not a separate stablecoin. Fund14 records its current maintenance/development work as in progress.

projects.name: Plastiks
projects.summary: Circular-economy verification platform developing Cardano-based plastic-recovery and recycling evidence, traceability and plastic-credit infrastructure.
projects.editorial_note: Plastiks is moving plastic-recovery verification and credit infrastructure onto Cardano. Its Fund13 Cardano Partners proposal is currently in progress; INDEX:80 records confirmed funded value from that proposal only.

projects.name: EPOCH Pool / No Stress dRep
projects.summary: Independent Cardano stake pool with a connected governance and education presence through the No Stress dRep and Cardano Over Coffee community activity.
projects.editorial_note: This record represents the EPOCH stake-pool project. The operator's No Stress dRep and education/community activity are related context rather than a separate INDEX:80 person record.

projects.name: PREEB Stake Pool
projects.summary: Small independent Cardano stake pool focused on decentralization, with a public delegation site and community/NFT reward activity.
projects.editorial_note: PREEB's official site identifies the pool ticker as PREEB and records its Cardano mainnet launch on 31 May 2022. INDEX:80 does not rank stake pools by rewards or return.

projects.name: BIKES Stake Pool
projects.summary: Community Cardano stake-pool operator with long-running mainnet activity and public involvement in Cardano testnet and infrastructure work.
projects.editorial_note: The current official X profile states BIKES has been online since epoch 242 and references MusashiNet and Mithril. Those technical-contribution details remain under editorial review.

projects.name: Saturn Swap
projects.summary: Cardano-focused decentralized exchange developing order-book and cross-chain trading infrastructure with Cardano-native settlement.
projects.editorial_note: Saturn Swap's current first-party material presents its V3 exchange and Cardano-native settlement model. Token and liquidity details should be treated as time-sensitive and checked before any spotlight copy.

projects.name: DeltaDeFi
projects.summary: Cardano decentralized exchange using Hydra Layer 2 for low-latency order confirmation and API-based trading.
projects.editorial_note: DeltaDeFi's current first-party site describes the exchange as live on mainnet and powered by Hydra L2. Performance and fee claims remain first-party product claims rather than INDEX:80 endorsements.

projects.name: SteelSwap DEX Aggregator
projects.summary: Cardano DEX aggregator that compares and routes swaps across multiple exchanges to improve execution output.
projects.editorial_note: SteelSwap's current product presents itself as a Cardano DEX aggregator using smart routing across available venues. INDEX:80 does not endorse quoted rates or execution outcomes.

projects.name: Flow
projects.summary: Open-source pooled lending protocol on Cardano designed for shared liquidity and capital-efficient lending markets.
projects.editorial_note: Flow's current site presents a pooled lending protocol on Cardano. Live market metrics and protocol usage are time-sensitive, so INDEX:80 does not reproduce them as fixed editorial facts.

projects.name: Surf
projects.summary: Open-source Cardano lending and borrowing protocol offering pooled markets and leveraged lending tools.
projects.editorial_note: Surf's current V2 product exposes live lending and borrowing functionality. Rates, liquidity and protocol metrics change continuously and are not editorial endorsements.

projects.name: No.Witness Labs
projects.summary: Blockchain security and smart-contract engineering studio providing audits and development services, with current Cardano and Hydra expertise.
projects.editorial_note: No.Witness Labs works across multiple chains. INDEX:80 includes it for current Cardano-facing security and engineering work; individual audit outcomes should be checked against the relevant project reports.

projects.name: Anzens / USDA
projects.summary: Issuer and access platform for USDA, a US-dollar-backed stablecoin designed initially for the Cardano ecosystem.
projects.editorial_note: Anzens' current material describes USDA as designed for 1:1 US-dollar backing and initially for Cardano. Current availability, reserve attestations and token identifiers must be verified before INDEX:80 presents USDA as live.

projects.name: GameChanger Wallet
projects.summary: Non-custodial Cardano metawallet and web-app platform designed for desktop and mobile access to wallets and Cardano dApps.
projects.editorial_note: GameChanger's current site presents its V2 wallet and dApp tooling as production-ready. Specific supported integrations remain subject to product updates.

projects.name: SyncAI Network
projects.summary: AI and DePIN network developing on-chain agent and communications infrastructure with an explicit Cardano implementation path.
projects.editorial_note: Current SyncAI material explicitly references an AI-powered DePIN network on Cardano. Its public-site routing is still being checked, so the X account remains the primary current identity link during REVIEW.

projects.name: Midgard
projects.summary: Optimistic-rollup Layer 2 for Cardano being developed by Anastasia Labs to increase throughput while settling back to Cardano.
projects.editorial_note: Midgard is currently a pre-alpha/testnet Cardano scaling project, not a mature production network. It is indexed separately from Anastasia Labs because it has its own protocol identity and public surface.

projects.name: Apex Fusion
projects.summary: Modular UTxO-and-EVM blockchain ecosystem using Ouroboros and Cardano-derived technology to bridge development across UTxO and account-based environments.
projects.editorial_note: Apex Fusion is its own blockchain ecosystem, not a Cardano L2 or Cardano-native dApp. INDEX:80 includes it because its current architecture explicitly uses Ouroboros, references Cardano's UTxO ecosystem and derives parts of its stack from Cardano technology.

projects.name: Flux Point Studios
projects.summary: Cardano-focused software studio developing gaming, AI-agent and developer tooling, including Cardano SDK and on-chain integration work.
projects.editorial_note: Flux Point Studios works across competitive gaming and AI tooling. INDEX:80 includes it for current Cardano-facing development work; individual products and token references remain separate claims to verify at product level.

projects.name: Powered by Cardano
projects.summary: Cardano ecosystem media platform publishing interviews, project coverage, live-event reporting and news updates.
projects.editorial_note: Powered by Cardano is indexed as ecosystem media rather than as a protocol or financial product. Its stake-pool and Midnight community roles are related operator context.

projects.name: Poki Portfolio
projects.summary: Cardano mobile portfolio application for tracking ADA, NFTs and collection holdings across a user's Cardano portfolio.
projects.editorial_note: Poki is a portfolio-tracking application rather than a custody wallet. App-store availability and feature coverage can change and should be checked at future reviews.

projects.name: Clarity Protocol
projects.summary: Governance platform for Cardano communities providing proposals, voting, treasury workflows, contributor rewards and community operations.
projects.editorial_note: Clarity provides governance infrastructure for Cardano communities and is listed in Cardano's current governance-tools directory. The account's dRep activity is related governance participation, not a separate project identity.

projects.name: INDEX:80
projects.summary: Open-source, independently maintained directory and structured dataset of active projects building on or materially connected to Cardano.
projects.editorial_note: INDEX:80 is an open-source, independently maintained directory and structured dataset for the active Cardano ecosystem. It connects evidence across project websites, X, LinkedIn, GitHub, Catalyst and on-chain sources. Inclusion is based on activity and evidence, not payment.

projects.name: DIA
